help.title: EduSchedule Help Center
help.subtitle: Welcome to the help center. Here you can find all the guides to operate your center as smoothly as possible.
help.supportDesc: If you encounter technical issues or need deeper advice, contact our technical team.

gettingStarted.title: Quick Start
gettingStarted.desc: Setting the foundation for your center.
gettingStarted.step2: Set up a list of Classrooms at each branch.
gettingStarted.details: Start by creating at least one **Branch**. This is where all your data is managed. Then, create **Classrooms** and assign them to the newly created branch. Finally, don't forget to go to **Settings** to update the Center Name displayed in the system header.

scheduling.title: Schedule Management
scheduling.desc: The heart of the management system.
scheduling.step1: Create Classes and assign Teachers in charge.
scheduling.step2: Use the Schedule Board to arrange class sessions.
scheduling.step3: Sync calendar with Google Calendar to receive notifications.
scheduling.details: The scheduling system uses a modern drag-and-drop interface. You just need to select a Class, Teacher, and Classroom to create a teaching session. To receive automatic notifications, click the **Connect Google Calendar** button in the Settings page. The system will automatically sync your teaching schedule to your personal phone.

data.title: Data Management
data.step1: Add new or use the Import feature to bulk add students.
data.step2: Manage profiles and track learning progress.
data.details: You can add individuals or use the **Import Data** feature from Excel. Note: Email is the unique identifier; the system will automatically block duplicate emails to ensure data integrity.

admin.title: System Admin
admin.step1: Manage Service Plans and system limits.
admin.details: The Dashboard page provides an overview of the number of students, teachers, and upcoming class sessions. Super Admins have control over Service Plans to limit the number of branches or classes depending on operational needs.

tip1.a: Click the Globe icon in the top header.

tip2.a: Click the Moon/Sun icon next to the language button.

tip3.a: Ensure your file has required columns like Full Name and Email.
